name: Yuliang Fu
description: Yuliang Fu is a Computer Science Ph.D. student at NC State University with interests in artificial intelligence, sensing, and computing for health.

news.text: EpiPad appears at ACM IMWUT / UbiComp 2026.
Received the Graduate Merit Award from North Carolina State University.
Serving on the Technical Program Committee and as a reviewer for IEEE BSN 2026.
Three papers at IEEE BSN 2025: TouchWave, mV-IMU, and Hand-Grip Strength Estimation.
Received the NC State GSA Travel Assistance Award and the IEEE BSN Student Travel Award.
Started my Ph.D. in Computer Science at NC State, joining the SSCS Lab advised by Dr. Chenhan Xu.

experience.description: Developing sensing and learning methods for everyday computing and health applications.
Used sensor data to analyze workloads and improve task allocation.
Explored sensing and machine learning with everyday devices.
Developed sensing and communication methods for connected devices.
